events.title: Wearable Devices Receives U.S. Patent Grant for Biometric
events.summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. (Nasdaq: WLDS, WLDSW) has been granted a new U.S. patent for biometric user authentication in its gesture and voice-controlled interface devices. This patent strengthens the company's intellectual property by covering technologies that authenticate users based on combined gesture and unique biological signals, enabling secure payments and authorized actions. The technology is expected to become a key feature in future wearables, positioning Wearable Devices at the forefront of human-computer interaction.

events.title: Apple, Amazon and other corporate giants quietly scrap board diversity rules
events.summary: Many major U.S. companies, including Apple, Amazon, and Starbucks, have quietly removed explicit diversity criteria for their board members and, in some cases, for CEO succession. This retreat from diversity, equity, and inclusion policies accelerated in the past year, with 61 S&P 100 companies dumping such criteria since 2023. While some companies like Microsoft still maintain diversity commitments, the shift reflects a broader trend influenced by conservative activism and an increased preference for former CEOs in board positions, who are predominantly White men.

events.title: Making sense of the conflicting 20th anniversary iPhone reports
events.summary: Recent reports regarding Apple's 20th anniversary iPhone are conflicting, with one analyst suggesting the "all-glass" vision has been halted due to low yield, while a Bloomberg reporter indicates the plan is still on track. The article discusses Apple's long-term vision of a "single slab of glass" iPhone, potentially incorporating under-display Face ID and cameras. It suggests that next year's iPhone design will be a significant step forward, likely impacting the iPhone Pro models, and questions whether special branding will be used for the anniversary.

events.title: Intel raises $20-billion from upsized share offering as it funds chipmaking expansion
events.summary: Intel has successfully raised US$20-billion through an upsized share offering, aiming to finance its ambitious expansion into chip contract manufacturing. The company priced the offering at US$95 per share, capitalizing on a significant stock surge driven by its turnaround efforts. This capital infusion is crucial for Intel as it invests heavily in new facilities and advanced packaging to compete with industry leaders like TSMC.

events.title: China Targeted MP Materials for a Reason
events.summary: China's control over rare earth magnets, crucial for modern technology like EVs and robots, presents a significant geopolitical and economic risk, reminiscent of the 1973 oil embargo. The U.S. is investing heavily in domestic alternatives, with MP Materials emerging as a key player in building a mine-to-magnet supply chain. This strategic shift positions rare earth companies as national security investments, offering substantial growth potential as global demand for these materials triples.

events.title: Almost all top US companies, including Starbucks, Alphabet, had board diversity rules. Now most are gone
events.summary: A new analysis by ESGAUGE reveals that 61 S&P 100 companies, including Apple, Alphabet, Amazon, Starbucks, and Wells Fargo, have eliminated explicit diversity criteria for future board members since 2023. This widespread rollback signals a significant retreat from diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) initiatives in corporate boardrooms. The shift has also affected CEO succession planning, with many companies removing diversity language from their criteria, while some, like Microsoft, still maintain such commitments.

events.title: Apple class action alleges Hide My Email feature does not work as advertised
events.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Apple Inc. alleging that its "Hide My Email" privacy feature does not work as advertised. The plaintiff claims that Apple misrepresented the feature's ability to conceal users' real email addresses, despite marketing it as a core privacy component of its products and services. Security researchers reportedly discovered that the feature has a flaw allowing real email addresses to be uncovered, and Apple is accused of failing to fix this issue despite knowing about it for over a year.

events.title: Apple Sued Over Alleged Privacy Gaps in ‘Private Relay’ Service
events.summary: Apple Inc. is being sued by a California man who claims the company falsely advertised its iCloud Private Relay feature, which was supposed to hide users' IP addresses and browsing activity. The lawsuit alleges that flaws in Apple’s WebKit browser engine allowed websites to still see users’ real IP addresses, contradicting Apple's promise that no single party could see both a user's identity and their web traffic destination.

events.title: Apple Pay chief Jennifer Bailey to retire in October - report
events.summary: Jennifer Bailey, the executive who has led Apple's Pay and Wallet services since 2014, will retire in October after more than 20 years with the company. events.title: Can You Identify Winning Stocks in Advance?

events.title: Apple ended support early for five Apple Watch models, new class action alleges
events.summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed against Apple Inc. alleging that the company prematurely ended software support for five Apple Watch models, including the Series 6, 7, 8, SE (2nd generation), and Ultra. The lawsuit claims Apple sold these devices for up to $799 without disclosing the limited software support, causing consumers to be stuck with potentially buggy or slow devices. Plaintiff Richard Goetz seeks compensatory and punitive damages, restitution, and injunctive relief, claiming breach of contract and violation of California's Unfair Competition Law.

events.summary: TradeStation Securities has launched CME Group Single Stock Futures (SSFs), allowing traders to take long or short positions on individual U.S. stocks without owning the underlying shares. These financially settled futures contracts are available in standard and micro sizes for over 50 leading U.S. stocks, including mega-cap technology and growth names, and offer features like margin-based capital efficiency and nearly 24/7 trading. This expansion provides active traders with another leveraged tool to express directional views on individual equities.

events.title: The 30-Year Battle for the Apple Name: Apple Inc. vs. Apple Corps
events.summary: This article details the 30-year legal battle between Apple Computer (later Apple Inc.) and Apple Corps, the multimedia company founded by The Beatles. The conflict, stemming from both companies using the "Apple" name, involved multiple lawsuits and settlements, ultimately concluding with Apple Inc. buying out all "Apple" trademark rights from Apple Corps for $500 million. The dispute highlights the challenges of trademark protection and the evolving nature of industries.

events.title: ‘Surprise and shine’: Apple to hold first major iPhone launch under new CEO next month
events.summary: Apple is set to hold its first major iPhone launch event under new CEO John Ternus on September 9, where it is expected to unveil the first foldable iPhone. This event is highly anticipated as it will also be Ternus's first opportunity to outline his vision for the company, with analysts predicting a strong focus on AI-powered gadgets. The introduction of a foldable iPhone could significantly boost Apple's revenue and challenge Samsung's dominance in the niche foldable phone market, potentially leading to higher iPhone prices.

events.title: HP beats on earnings and revenue but PC unit slump sinks the stock
events.summary: HP Inc. reported third-quarter earnings and revenue that exceeded analyst expectations, with adjusted earnings of 83 cents per share on revenue of $15.68 billion. Despite this, the company's stock fell over 9% due to a significant 16% decline in Personal Systems shipments. HP raised its full-year outlook, forecasting adjusted earnings between $3.19 and $3.29 per share, driven by higher selling prices and gains in premium products.

events.title: Cirrus Logic stock hits 52-week low at 109.81 USD
events.summary: Cirrus Logic (CRUS) stock has hit a 52-week low of $109.81, currently trading at $109.43 with a market cap of $5.5 billion, marking a significant decline from its 52-week high of $180.42. Despite a recent slight earnings beat in Q1 fiscal 2027, the company's revenue guidance led to a price target reduction by Stifel, impacting investor sentiment. InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock is significantly undervalued with a "GREAT" financial health score, even as it trades in oversold territory based on RSI and has a P/E ratio of 13.6.

events.title: Squadron Capital sells $943k in OrthoPediatrics stock
events.summary: Squadron Capital LLC, a significant owner of OrthoPediatrics Corp (NASDAQ:KIDS), recently sold approximately $943,302 worth of common stock over three days in late August 2026. These sales, which occurred at prices between $24.28 and $25.75 per share, were conducted to provide capital for other portfolio businesses. The transactions took place amidst stock volatility, as KIDS declined 8.4% in the week of the sales, though it maintained strong year-to-date gains of 35% and had recently reported a 15% increase in second-quarter revenue.

events.title: MML VIP Franklin Templeton Equity Fund's Apple Inc(AAPL) Holding History
events.summary: The article details the MML VIP Franklin Templeton Equity Fund's historical holdings in Apple Inc (AAPL) as of June 30, 2026. The fund holds 86,900 shares of AAPL valued at $25.15 million, representing 2.66% of its portfolio. Since its initial trade in Q3 2019, the fund has made two purchases and four sales, resulting in an estimated gain of $8.58 million, or 19.21%.

events.title: Ollie’s Bargain Outlet shares may move 3.5% on earnings
events.summary: Ollie’s Bargain Outlet Holdings Inc. (OLLI) shares are projected to move 3.5% based on options data ahead of its upcoming earnings report on September 2. The company's stock price has historically shown more significant movement than options implied in previous earnings announcements. For instance, in December 2024, shares moved 11.2% against an implied 7.9% and in August 2024, it dropped 12.3% versus a 7.0% implied move.

events.title: Roundhill Ball Metaverse ETF (METV) holdings
events.summary: This article provides details on the Roundhill Ball Metaverse ETF (METV) holdings as of August 14th, including its top 10 holdings, sector weightings, and overall portfolio composition. The ETF aims to track companies involved in the Metaverse, with a significant allocation to technology and communication services. It also lists key financial metrics and related tickers.

events.title: Assurant Reports Mobile Trade-In Programs Return $1.43 Billion to Consumers in Q2 2026 as Smartphones Reach Four-Year Upgrade Milestone
events.summary: Assurant's Q2 2026 report reveals that mobile trade-in programs returned $1.43 billion to U.S. consumers, as the average age of traded-in iPhones exceeded four years for the first time. This trend highlights consumers' efforts to offset upgrade costs and extend the value of their devices, with strong demand for refurbished smartphones supporting healthy trade-in values. The company emphasizes the role of trade-in programs in making newer devices more affordable and contributing to a robust secondary market.

events.title: Assurant: Mobile Trade-In Programs Return $1.43 Billion to Consumers in the second quarter
events.summary: Mobile trade-in programs generated $1.43 billion for U.S. consumers in the second quarter of 2026, according to Assurant, Inc. The report highlights that iPhones traded in are now, on average, over four years old, and trade-in values are expanding beyond smartphones to include premium smartwatches like the Apple Watch Ultra 3. This trend indicates a consumer shift towards managing device costs and extending the life of their technology, with trade-ins playing a crucial role in making new devices affordable and supporting the refurbished market.

events.title: Redwood Investment Management LLC Takes $1.26 Million Position in The Walt Disney Company $DIS
events.summary: Redwood Investment Management LLC has initiated a new position in The Walt Disney Company (NYSE:DIS) during the second quarter, purchasing 13,067 shares valued at approximately $1.26 million. This investment comes as Disney shows improving financial momentum, with adjusted earnings exceeding estimates and revenue rising 6.8% year-over-year, driven by its Experiences segment and increasingly profitable streaming operations. Despite a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating from analysts, some cautionary signals exist, including executive share sales and planned restructuring-related retirements.

events.title: Northrim BanCorp, Inc. Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.17 per Share
events.summary: Northrim BanCorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: NRIM) announced that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share. This dividend will be payable on September 18, 2026, to shareholders who are on record at the close of business on September 10, 2026. The announcement was made in Anchorage, Alaska, on August 28, 2026.

events.title: Apple launches Klarna-backed leasing program to offset rising hardware costs
events.summary: Apple has partnered with Klarna to launch a new device leasing program for iPhones, Macs, iPads, and Watches, aiming to maintain sales volumes and encourage premium configurations despite rising hardware costs. This strategy offloads credit risk from Apple's balance sheet, with Klarna managing the financing. The program is seen as a critical test for the upcoming iPhone 18 cycle to offset higher upfront prices and sustain demand, especially as analyst targets for Apple's stock show wide divergence.

events.title: Lightning Round: Use Vale S.A. as a hedge if you think there's more inflation down the road
events.summary: Jim Cramer of 'Mad Money' advises using Vale S.A. as a hedge against potential future inflation. He also discusses other stocks including Apple, Cisco, and ERock. The article features a video segment from his show where he provides his analysis.

events.title: Jobs to double, output to triple at KY factory set to make all glass for iPhones
events.summary: Apple's $2.5 billion investment in Corning Inc.'s Harrodsburg, Kentucky facility will double jobs, triple output, and make it the sole manufacturer of glass for all iPhones and Apple Watches. This move is part of Apple's broader commitment to U.S. manufacturing, aiming to create more American jobs and reduce reliance on foreign production. The expansion also includes a new Apple-Corning Innovation Center for developing future product materials.

events.title: Mount Logan Capital Inc. Begins Trading on Nasdaq Under “MLCI”
events.summary: Mount Logan Capital Inc. (Nasdaq: MLCI) announced that its common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on Monday, September 15, 2025, under the ticker symbol “MLCI.” This follows the successful completion of Mount Logan’s all-stock Business Combination with 180 Degree Capital Corp. on Friday, September 12, 2025.

events.title: Apple implements price hikes for its TV streaming service and 'One' subscription bundle
events.summary: Apple has increased the prices for its Apple TV streaming service and its Apple One subscription bundle. Apple TV's monthly cost has risen from $12.99 to $14.99, while the Apple One individual plan is now $21.95, up from $19.95. This move follows similar price adjustments by other major streaming platforms and comes after Apple reported a record June quarter with $109.4 billion in revenue.

events.title: Soluna Holdings director Phelan sells $180,347 of preferred stock By Investing.com
events.summary: William P. Phelan, a director at Soluna Holdings, Inc., sold $180,347 worth of the company's 9.0% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock in late August through three separate transactions. The sales occurred at prices ranging from $12.00 to $12.09 per share, as the stock trades near its 52-week high after a 266% gain over the past year. InvestingPro analysis indicates the stock may be overvalued, potentially influencing Phelan's decision to reduce his position.

events.title: Paysign Targets $117M Revenue as Patient-Affordability Business Surges
events.summary: Paysign (NASDAQ: PAYS) is projecting revenue between $114 million and $117 million for the current year, driven by significant growth in its patient-affordability business, which is expected to reach $60 million in revenue. The company also anticipates plasma revenue to hit nearly $57 million. Paysign attributes its financial strength to operating leverage from shared infrastructure and a robust balance sheet with over $30 million in unrestricted cash and no bank debt, supporting its expansion efforts in both healthcare-focused segments.

events.title: Apple class action claims iCloud Private Relay exposes users’ IP addresses
events.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Apple Inc., alleging that the company misrepresented the privacy protections of its iCloud Private Relay feature. Plaintiff Maria Rosado-Wright claims that despite Apple's advertisements, the feature's WebKit browser engine exposes users' real IP addresses, leading consumers to overpay for iCloud+ subscriptions. The lawsuit seeks damages and restitution for affected iCloud+ subscribers.

events.title: Apple TV raises prices without offering an ad tier, testing how much viewers will pay
events.summary: Apple TV has increased its subscription prices for the fourth time in four years, with monthly plans now costing $14.99 and annual plans $119.99. Unlike many competitors, Apple TV does not offer a cheaper, ad-supported tier. This move positions Apple TV as the latest streamer to raise prices, following companies like Netflix, Peacock, ESPN, Amazon Prime Video, and YouTube Premium, as the industry aims to offset rising programming costs.
